text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk on my day off,
I heard some familiar voices.
It looks like they're about to play a basketball game...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy!
I'm gonna hit nothin' but three-pointers today!

text_block_list.name: Team Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Even though Pokke is over there too!?
So cool~...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Jordan! Seriously!
Like anyone could pull off some superhuman stunt like that~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...
Guess I'll do it then."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Looks like they chickened out before even trying, so how about we show 'em how it's done instead?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm not freaked out or anything.
I mean, you can tell it's just a joke, right—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Listen up, you bastards!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm drainin' every single one from the three-point line!
Keep your eyes peeled and watch this!!

text_block_list.name: Team Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—For real?!
—Whoo! Pokke, you're the coolest~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...What's your deal?
Where does it come from? That confidence...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, pass the ball!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Too slow, too slow!
That's 3 points for me!!"
(Swish! *TWEET!*)

text_block_list.name: Team Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, another three-pointer...
I mean, seriously, she did exactly what she said she would!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That's why I told you I'd do it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I ain't like those cowards who talk big
without any confidence and then back down.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Y-You... You listen hereee!!
Letting you run your mouth like thattt--!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y-You little!
Pass me the ball!!
(Swish! *TWEEET!!*)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so you sank a three.
Won't mean a thing if it's just a one-off, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who the hell would stop after just one try?!
Just you watch, dammit!

Tosen Jordan aggressively stole the ball
and fired off three-pointer after three-pointer.
Then the final whistle blew—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I, lost.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Dammit, dammit, dammit!
If I had just sunk one more 3-pointer...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Well, you did better than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What's with that look? I'm complimenting you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, once you make a declaration, brace yourself.
Chickening out is totally lame.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get scared of your own words.
Got it?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit... Shit, shit!
What do they know anyway?!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Saying it without any hesitation!
And then actually going and doing it?!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... damn it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......'cause it's so freakin' cool.

After the match ended, I called out to
Tosen Jordan. She seemed to be pondering
something with uncharacteristic seriousness—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. What is it with people who can just casually talk about doing huge things?
choice_data_list: Seems like you're pretty confident, huh.
Seems like you're pretty confident, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. What is it with people who can just casually talk about doing huge things?
choice_data_list: Seems like you're pretty confident, huh.
Seems like you're pretty confident, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I have confidence...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Confidence, confidence, huh.
No idea how you're even supposed to get it, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I'll ever be able to say it
like that one day..."

"Tosen Jordan clutches her head.
However, her sincere struggle to move forward
was felt loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-who cares what it is!
Stop asking already!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, well?
How should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even if I suddenly start talking really big...
don't laugh, okay?

Even if it was still hard to say, and not easy at all.
A small change had clearly begun to take place
within Tosen Jordan.
